<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0b2a5e">
<title>Sabor da Praia — Cardápio Digital</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#0d2a5e; --navy2:#123a80; --deep:#061a3c;
  --gold:#f9b81f; --gold2:#ffd464; --gold3:#c98a10;
  --cream:#fdeccd; --sand:#eccf9a; --sand2:#e0b877;
  --sky1:#0a5aa0; --sky2:#2f97d4; --sky3:#8fd2ee;
  --sun1:#ffe1a1; --sun2:#ff9f4d;
  --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(6,26,60,.35);
  --bar:64px;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  font-family:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  background:var(--deep); color:#fff; overflow-x:hidden;
  overscroll-behavior-y:none;
}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
.f{font-family:'Baloo 2','Inter',sans-serif}

/* ---------- particles ---------- */
#fx{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:60}

/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
#hero{
  position:relative; min-height:100svh; min-height:100vh;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  padding:34px 20px 90px; overflow:hidden; isolation:isolate;
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 62%, rgba(255,214,140,.85) 0%, rgba(255,190,110,0) 55%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,
      #0e6ab4 0%, #1b83cc 13%, #45a8dd 28%, #9adcf4 43%,
      #ffd79a 55%, #ffab63 62%, #f0d3a1 70%, #e8c68c 84%, #dcb478 100%);
}
/* sol */
#hero .sun{
  position:absolute; left:50%; top:52%; width:190px; height:190px; margin:-95px 0 0 -95px;
  border-radius:50%; z-index:-2;
  background:radial-gradient(circle, #fff7e0 0%, var(--sun1) 38%, rgba(255,159,77,.55) 62%, rgba(255,159,77,0) 72%);
  filter:blur(1px); animation:sunPulse 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes sunPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.95}50%{transform:scale(1.09);opacity:1}}
/* mar */
#hero .sea{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:69%;height:13%;z-index:-2;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,170,90,.55), rgba(23,110,170,.75) 45%, rgba(12,74,130,.9));
  filter:blur(.4px)}
#hero .sea:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.16) 0 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0) 2px 9px);
  animation:seaMove 7s linear infinite; opacity:.6}
@keyframes seaMove{to{transform:translateY(9px)}}
/* areia */
#hero .sand{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:19%;z-index:-2;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f2dcae,#e3bd80 55%,#d8ad6b);}
#hero .sand:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.35;
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(160,110,50,.5) .8px, transparent .9px);
  background-size:7px 7px}
/* ondas */
.waves{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(69% + 11%);z-index:-1;width:200%;height:48px}
.waves path{fill:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.waves.w2{opacity:.55;top:calc(69% + 9%);animation:wave 9s linear infinite reverse}
.waves.w1{animation:wave 12s linear infinite}
@keyframes wave{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
/* palmeiras */
.palm{position:absolute;top:-18px;z-index:-1;width:245px;opacity:.95;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 16px rgba(6,26,60,.35))}
.palm path{fill:#08234c}
.palm.l{left:-58px;transform-origin:top left;animation:sway 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.palm.r{right:-58px;transform:scaleX(-1);transform-origin:top right;animation:sway2 8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-2.5deg)}50%{transform:rotate(2.5deg)}}
@keyframes sway2{0%,100%{transform:scaleX(-1) rotate(-3deg)}50%{transform:scaleX(-1) rotate(2deg)}}
/* gaivotas */
.gull{position:absolute;z-index:-1;opacity:.65;animation:fly 26s linear infinite}
.gull svg{width:26px;stroke:#0a2550;stroke-width:2.4;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round}
.gull.g2{animation-duration:34s;animation-delay:-9s;opacity:.5}
.gull.g3{animation-duration:30s;animation-delay:-17s;opacity:.4}
@keyframes fly{
  0%{transform:translate(-12vw,26vh) scale(.75)}
  50%{transform:translate(50vw,17vh) scale(1)}
  100%{transform:translate(115vw,29vh) scale(.7)}
}

/* logo */
.logo-wrap{perspective:900px;margin-bottom:20px}
.logo-card{
  width:min(70vw,272px); border-radius:26px; overflow:hidden; position:relative;
  border:3px solid var(--gold); background:#0b2a5e;
  box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(6,26,60,.5), 0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  transform-style:preserve-3d; transition:transform .18s ease-out;
  animation:floaty 5.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes floaty{0%,100%{margin-top:0}50%{margin-top:-9px}}
.logo-card img{width:100%}
.logo-card .shine{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:-60%;left:-60%;width:60%;height:250%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(255,255,255,.55),rgba(255,255,255,0));
  transform:rotate(22deg); animation:shine 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes shine{0%{left:-70%}55%{left:130%}100%{left:130%}}

.hero-tag{
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;
  color:#0a2550;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border:1px solid rgba(10,37,80,.25);
  padding:7px 15px;border-radius:99px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);margin-bottom:14px
}
h1.hero-title{
  font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(38px,13vw,58px);line-height:.95;
  color:var(--gold2); text-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--gold3), 0 6px 16px rgba(6,26,60,.55), 0 0 26px rgba(255,200,80,.35);
  -webkit-text-stroke:1.5px #0a2550; letter-spacing:.01em; text-align:center;
}
.hero-sub{margin-top:10px;text-align:center;color:#0a2550;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5);max-width:320px}
.cta{
  margin-top:26px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;
  color:#0a2550;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));
  border:2px solid #0a2550;border-radius:99px;padding:13px 28px;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:0 8px 0 #0a2550, 0 14px 26px rgba(6,26,60,.4);
  transition:transform .12s, box-shadow .12s;
}
.cta:active{transform:translateY(6px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #0a2550,0 6px 14px rgba(6,26,60,.4)}
.cta .arw{animation:bob 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(4px)}}
.scroll-hint{position:absolute;bottom:22px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#0a2550;font-weight:700;opacity:.75;text-transform:uppercase}

/* ---------- TOPBAR ---------- */
#menu{position:relative;background:
   linear-gradient(180deg,#0d2a5e,#0a2350 40%,#081d44);
   padding-bottom:calc(var(--bar) + 26px)}
#menu:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.055;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.9) 1px, transparent 1.4px);background-size:22px 22px}
#topbar{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(9,32,72,.98),rgba(9,32,72,.92));
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  border-bottom:2px solid rgba(249,184,31,.35);
  box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.brandline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:11px 14px 8px}
.brandline .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--gold)}
.brandline b{font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:.02em}
.brandline span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9fc0e8;margin-left:auto}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:0 12px 11px;scrollbar-width:none;scroll-behavior:smooth}
.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tab{
  flex:0 0 auto;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;
  color:#bfd6f2;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  padding:9px 15px;border-radius:99px;cursor:pointer;transition:.22s;
}
.tab.on{color:#0a2550;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));border-color:var(--gold2);
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(249,184,31,.4)}

/* ---------- PAGER ---------- */
.stage{padding:16px 12px 0}
.viewport{overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;transition:height .38s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.track{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;will-change:transform}
.slide{flex:0 0 100%;padding:0 4px}
.card{
  border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  border:2px solid rgba(249,184,31,.55);
  box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  background:#12224a;
}
.card img{width:100%;height:auto}
.hintbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  margin:0 auto 12px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:99px;width:max-content;max-width:100%;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.01em;color:#0a2550;white-space:nowrap;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));
  border:1.5px solid rgba(10,37,80,.55);
  box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  animation:hintPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes hintPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.82;transform:translateY(0)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-2px)}}

/* ---------- BOTTOM PAGE BAR ---------- */
#pagebar{
  position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:50;
  transform:translateY(130%);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  padding:0 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  pointer-events:none;
}
#pagebar.show{transform:translateY(0)}
.pb-inner{
  pointer-events:auto;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,36,80,.97),rgba(7,26,60,.97));
  border:1.5px solid rgba(249,184,31,.5);border-radius:18px;
  padding:9px 12px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
}
.pb-num{
  font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:19px;line-height:1;
  color:#0a2550;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));
  border-radius:12px;padding:8px 11px;min-width:56px;text-align:center;
  box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--gold3);
}
.pb-num small{font-size:12px;opacity:.7;font-weight:700}
.pb-mid{flex:1;min-width:0}
.pb-label{font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--gold2);
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;line-height:1.1}
.pb-dots{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.pb-dots i{width:100%;height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);transition:.3s}
.pb-dots i.on{background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(249,184,31,.8)}
.pb-nav{display:flex;gap:6px}
.pb-nav button{
  width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:var(--gold2);font-size:17px;cursor:pointer;
  display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.18s
}
.pb-nav button:active{transform:scale(.9);background:rgba(249,184,31,.25)}
.pb-nav button[disabled]{opacity:.28}

/* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
#info{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#081d44,#040f26);padding:34px 16px calc(118px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  border-top:2px solid rgba(249,184,31,.3)}
.warn{
  display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:center;border-radius:16px;padding:15px 16px;margin:0 auto 14px;max-width:520px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
.warn .ic{flex:0 0 auto;width:44px;height:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:12px;font-size:24px}
.warn .tx{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:600}
.warn.alerg{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8a5a24,#63400f);border:2px solid #f2c14e}
.warn.alerg .ic{background:#f7d64a;color:#4a2f06;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #b8930f}
.warn.alerg b{display:block;font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:#ffdf7a;letter-spacing:.03em}
.warn.alerg .tx{color:#ffeecb}
.warn.drink{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#123a80,#0b2a5e);border:2px solid rgba(249,184,31,.45)}
.warn.drink .ic{background:#0a2550;color:#ffd464;border:1.5px solid rgba(249,184,31,.5)}
.warn.drink b{display:block;font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:#ffd464;letter-spacing:.03em}
.warn.drink .tx{color:#cfe1f8}

/* ---------- ZOOM VIEWER ---------- */
#zoom{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(4,12,28,.97);
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;
  touch-action:none;
}
#zoom.open{display:flex;animation:fadeIn .22s ease}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
#zoom img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;will-change:transform;transform-origin:0 0}
#zclose{
  position:absolute;top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top));right:12px;z-index:2;
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid rgba(249,184,31,.6);
  background:rgba(11,36,80,.9);color:var(--gold2);font-size:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer
}
#zhint{
  position:absolute;bottom:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#cfe1f8;background:rgba(11,36,80,.85);
  border:1px solid rgba(249,184,31,.35);border-radius:99px;padding:8px 15px;white-space:nowrap;
  transition:opacity .4s
}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<canvas id="fx"></canvas>

<!-- ================= HERO ================= -->
<section id="hero">
  <div class="sun"></div>
  <div class="sea"></div>
  <div class="sand"></div>

  <svg class="waves w2" viewBox="0 0 1200 60" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0,30 C150,60 250,0 400,26 C550,52 650,4 800,28 C950,52 1050,6 1200,30 L1200,60 L0,60 Z"></path></svg>
  <svg class="waves w1" viewBox="0 0 1200 60" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0,34 C120,6 260,58 420,32 C580,6 700,56 860,32 C1000,10 1100,50 1200,34 L1200,60 L0,60 Z"></path></svg>

  <svg class="palm l" viewBox="0 0 220 170"><g>
    <path d="M12 6 C78 -2 152 24 206 74 C150 40 82 26 14 28 Z" transform="rotate(-10 12 6)"/>
    <path d="M12 6 C78 -2 152 24 206 74 C150 40 82 26 14 28 Z" transform="rotate(12 12 6)"/>
    <path d="M12 6 C74 0 140 30 186 84 C136 48 76 32 14 30 Z" transform="rotate(34 12 6)"/>
    <path d="M12 6 C70 2 128 34 168 90 C124 54 70 36 14 30 Z" transform="rotate(58 12 6)"/>
    <path d="M12 6 C62 4 110 36 142 88 C106 56 62 38 14 30 Z" transform="rotate(80 12 6)"/>
  </g></svg>
  <svg class="palm r" viewBox="0 0 220 170"><g>
    <path d="M12 6 C78 -2 152 24 206 74 C150 40 82 26 14 28 Z" transform="rotate(-10 12 6)"/>
    <path d="M12 6 C78 -2 152 24 206 74 C150 40 82 26 14 28 Z" transform="rotate(12 12 6)"/>
    <path d="M12 6 C74 0 140 30 186 84 C136 48 76 32 14 30 Z" transform="rotate(34 12 6)"/>
    <path d="M12 6 C70 2 128 34 168 90 C124 54 70 36 14 30 Z" transform="rotate(58 12 6)"/>
    <path d="M12 6 C62 4 110 36 142 88 C106 56 62 38 14 30 Z" transform="rotate(80 12 6)"/>
  </g></svg>

  <div class="gull g1"><svg viewBox="0 0 40 16"><path d="M2 10c5-8 9-8 13 0 4-8 8-8 13 0"/></svg></div>
  <div class="gull g2"><svg viewBox="0 0 40 16"><path d="M2 10c5-8 9-8 13 0 4-8 8-8 13 0"/></svg></div>
  <div class="gull g3"><svg viewBox="0 0 40 16"><path d="M2 10c5-8 9-8 13 0 4-8 8-8 13 0"/></svg></div>

  <div class="logo-wrap">
    <div class="logo-card" id="logoCard">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Sabor da Praia — Restaurante e Petisqueira">
      <div class="shine"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="hero-tag">Restaurante e Petisqueira</div>
  <h1 class="hero-title f">CARDÁPIO</h1>
  <p class="hero-sub">Seis páginas com todos os nossos petiscos, porções, pratos e bebidas. Deslize para o lado para navegar.</p>

  <button class="cta f" id="goMenu">VER CARDÁPIO <span class="arw">↓</span></button>
  <div class="scroll-hint">deslize para baixo</div>
</section>

<!-- ================= MENU ================= -->
<section id="menu">
  <div id="topbar">
    <div class="brandline">
      <i class="dot"></i>
      <b>Sabor da Praia</b>
      <span id="bcount">1 de 6</span>
    </div>
    <div class="tabs" id="tabs"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="stage">
    <div class="hintbar">🔍 toque para ampliar · ↔ deslize para trocar</div>
    <div class="viewport" id="viewport">
      <div class="track" id="track">
        <div class="slide"><div class="card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Entradas e Petiscos" style="aspect-ratio:1024/1536" loading="eager"></div></div>
        <div class="slide"><div class="card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Porções e Combinados" style="aspect-ratio:1055/1490" loading="lazy"></div></div>
        <div class="slide"><div class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pratos da Casa" style="aspect-ratio:1055/1491" loading="lazy"></div></div>
        <div class="slide"><div class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Bebidas e Drinks" style="aspect-ratio:1024/1536" loading="lazy"></div></div>
        <div class="slide"><div class="card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Bebidas sem Álcool" style="aspect-ratio:1024/1536" loading="lazy"></div></div>
        <div class="slide"><div class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Bebidas — Cervejas e Doses" style="aspect-ratio:1055/1490" loading="lazy"></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= PAGE BAR ================= -->
<div id="pagebar">
  <div class="pb-inner">
    <div class="pb-num f" id="pbNum">1<small>/6</small></div>
    <div class="pb-mid">
      <div class="pb-label f" id="pbLabel">Entradas &amp; Petiscos</div>
      <div class="pb-dots" id="pbDots"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pb-nav">
      <button id="prev" aria-label="Página anterior">‹</button>
      <button id="next" aria-label="Próxima página">›</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ================= INFO ================= -->
<footer id="info">
  <div class="warn alerg reveal">
    <div class="ic">⚠</div>
    <div class="tx"><b>PARA QUEM É ALÉRGICO</b>Informe na hora do pedido. Nós podemos orientar!</div>
  </div>
  <div class="warn drink reveal">
    <div class="ic">🍺</div>
    <div class="tx"><b>SE BEBER, NÃO DIRIJA</b>Venda de bebida alcoólica apenas para maiores de 18 anos.</div>
  </div>
</footer>

<!-- ================= ZOOM ================= -->
<div id="zoom">
  <button id="zclose" aria-label="Fechar">✕</button>
  <img id="zimg" alt="">
  <div id="zhint">pinça para ampliar · toque duplo · arraste</div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

/* ---------------- dados ---------------- */
var CATS=[
 {full:"Entradas & Petiscos", short:"Entradas"},
 {full:"Porções & Combinados", short:"Porções"},
 {full:"Pratos da Casa",       short:"Pratos"},
 {full:"Bebidas — Drinks",     short:"Drinks"},
 {full:"Bebidas sem Álcool",   short:"Sem Álcool"},
 {full:"Cervejas & Doses",     short:"Cervejas"}
];
var N=CATS.length, idx=0;

var track=document.getElementById('track'),
    viewport=document.getElementById('viewport'),
    slides=track.children,
    tabs=document.getElementById('tabs'),
    pbNum=document.getElementById('pbNum'),
    pbLabel=document.getElementById('pbLabel'),
    pbDots=document.getElementById('pbDots'),
    bcount=document.getElementById('bcount'),
    pagebar=document.getElementById('pagebar'),
    prevB=document.getElementById('prev'),
    nextB=document.getElementById('next');

/* abas + pontinhos */
CATS.forEach(function(c,i){
  var b=document.createElement('button');
  b.className='tab'; b.textContent=(i+1)+'. '+c.short;
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){ go(i); scrollToMenu(); });
  tabs.appendChild(b);
  var d=document.createElement('i'); pbDots.appendChild(d);
});
var tabEls=tabs.children, dotEls=pbDots.children;

/* ---------------- pager ---------------- */
var dragging=false, animOn=true;
function setX(px,anim){
  track.style.transition = anim ? 'transform .42s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)' : 'none';
  track.style.transform  = 'translate3d('+px+'px,0,0)';
}
function baseX(){ return -idx*viewport.clientWidth; }

function syncHeight(){
  var h=slides[idx].firstElementChild.offsetHeight;
  if(h>0) viewport.style.height=h+'px';
}
function paint(){
  pbNum.innerHTML=(idx+1)+'<small>/'+N+'</small>';
  pbLabel.textContent=CATS[idx].full;
  bcount.textContent=(idx+1)+' de '+N;
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++){
    tabEls[i].classList.toggle('on',i===idx);
    dotEls[i].classList.toggle('on',i===idx);
  }
  prevB.disabled = idx===0; nextB.disabled = idx===N-1;
  var t=tabEls[idx];
  tabs.scrollTo({left:t.offsetLeft - tabs.clientWidth/2 + t.offsetWidth/2, behavior:'smooth'});
}
function go(i,anim){
  i=Math.max(0,Math.min(N-1,i));
  idx=i; paint(); syncHeight(); setX(baseX(), anim!==false);
}
prevB.addEventListener('click',function(){ go(idx-1); });
nextB.addEventListener('click',function(){ go(idx+1); });

/* swipe */
var sx=0, sy=0, dx=0, lock=null, t0=0;
viewport.style.touchAction='pan-y';
viewport.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){
  if(e.touches.length!==1) return;
  sx=e.touches[0].clientX; sy=e.touches[0].clientY; dx=0; lock=null; t0=Date.now();
  dragging=true;
},{passive:true});
viewport.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){
  if(!dragging||e.touches.length!==1) return;
  var mx=e.touches[0].clientX-sx, my=e.touches[0].clientY-sy;
  if(lock===null){
    if(Math.abs(mx)>7||Math.abs(my)>7) lock = Math.abs(mx)>Math.abs(my)*1.25 ? 'x':'y';
  }
  if(lock==='x'){
    e.preventDefault();
    dx=mx;
    if((idx===0&&dx>0)||(idx===N-1&&dx<0)) dx*=0.32;
    setX(baseX()+dx,false);
  }
},{passive:false});
viewport.addEventListener('touchend',function(){
  if(!dragging) return; dragging=false;
  if(lock!=='x'){ return; }
  var w=viewport.clientWidth, dt=Date.now()-t0, v=Math.abs(dx)/Math.max(dt,1);
  if(dx<-w*0.16 || (dx<-30 && v>0.5)) go(idx+1);
  else if(dx>w*0.16 || (dx>30 && v>0.5)) go(idx-1);
  else setX(baseX(),true);
  dx=0; lock=null;
},{passive:true});

/* teclado (desktop) */
window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(document.getElementById('zoom').classList.contains('open')) return;
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight') go(idx+1);
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')  go(idx-1);
});

/* ---------------- zoom viewer ---------------- */
var zoom=document.getElementById('zoom'), zimg=document.getElementById('zimg'),
    zhint=document.getElementById('zhint');
var zs=1, ztx=0, zty=0, zBase=1;

function zApply(){ zimg.style.transform='translate3d('+ztx+'px,'+zty+'px,0) scale('+zs+')'; }
function zReset(){
  zs=1; ztx=0; zty=0;
  zimg.style.transition='none';
  var r=zimg.getBoundingClientRect();
  zApply();
}
function openZoom(i){
  zimg.src=slides[i].firstElementChild.querySelector('img').src;
  zoom.classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  zs=1; ztx=0; zty=0; zApply();
  zhint.style.opacity='1';
  clearTimeout(openZoom._t);
  openZoom._t=setTimeout(function(){ zhint.style.opacity='0'; },2600);
}
function closeZoom(){
  zoom.classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}
document.getElementById('zclose').addEventListener('click',closeZoom);

/* abrir ao tocar na página (se não foi swipe) */
for(var i=0;i<N;i++){(function(i){
  var img=slides[i].firstElementChild.querySelector('img');
  var downX=0,downY=0,downT=0;
  img.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){ downX=e.clientX; downY=e.clientY; downT=Date.now(); });
  img.addEventListener('pointerup',function(e){
    if(Math.abs(e.clientX-downX)<10 && Math.abs(e.clientY-downY)<10 && Date.now()-downT<600) openZoom(i);
  });
})(i);}

/* gestos no viewer */
var pts={}, startDist=0, startScale=1, startMid={x:0,y:0}, startT={x:0,y:0};
var panning=false, panX=0, panY=0, lastTap=0;

function clampPan(){
  var r=zimg.getBoundingClientRect();
  var vw=window.innerWidth, vh=window.innerHeight;
  var w=zimg.offsetWidth*zs, h=zimg.offsetHeight*zs;
  var maxX=Math.max(0,(w-vw)/2), maxY=Math.max(0,(h-vh)/2);
  ztx=Math.max(-maxX,Math.min(maxX,ztx));
  zty=Math.max(-maxY,Math.min(maxY,zty));
}
zoom.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){
  zimg.style.transition='none';
  if(e.touches.length===2){
    var a=e.touches[0],b=e.touches[1];
    startDist=Math.hypot(a.clientX-b.clientX,a.clientY-b.clientY);
    startScale=zs; startT={x:ztx,y:zty};
    panning=false;
  }else if(e.touches.length===1){
    panning=true; panX=e.touches[0].clientX-ztx; panY=e.touches[0].clientY-zty;
  }
},{passive:true});
zoom.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  if(e.touches.length===2){
    var a=e.touches[0],b=e.touches[1];
    var d=Math.hypot(a.clientX-b.clientX,a.clientY-b.clientY);
    zs=Math.max(1,Math.min(6,startScale*(d/startDist)));
    clampPan(); zApply();
  }else if(e.touches.length===1&&panning&&zs>1){
    ztx=e.touches[0].clientX-panX; zty=e.touches[0].clientY-panY;
    clampPan(); zApply();
  }
},{passive:false});
zoom.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){
  if(e.touches.length===0){
    panning=false;
    if(zs<1.02){ zimg.style.transition='transform .25s ease'; zs=1; ztx=0; zty=0; zApply(); }
  }
},{passive:true});

/* duplo toque */
zoom.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  if(e.target.id==='zclose') return;
  var now=Date.now();
  if(now-lastTap<300){
    zimg.style.transition='transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)';
    if(zs>1.2){ zs=1; ztx=0; zty=0; }
    else{
      zs=2.6;
      var vw=window.innerWidth, vh=window.innerHeight;
      ztx=(vw/2-e.clientX)*(zs-1); zty=(vh/2-e.clientY)*(zs-1);
      clampPan();
    }
    zApply();
  }else if(zs<=1.02 && e.target.id!=='zimg'){
    closeZoom();
  }
  lastTap=now;
});
/* roda do mouse (desktop) */
zoom.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){
  e.preventDefault(); zimg.style.transition='none';
  zs=Math.max(1,Math.min(6, zs*(e.deltaY<0?1.12:0.89)));
  if(zs===1){ztx=0;zty=0;} clampPan(); zApply();
},{passive:false});
window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape') closeZoom(); });

/* ---------------- barra inferior aparece com o menu ---------------- */
var menuEl=document.getElementById('menu');
if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
  new IntersectionObserver(function(en){
    en.forEach(function(x){ pagebar.classList.toggle('show', x.isIntersecting); });
  },{threshold:0, rootMargin:'-15% 0px -25% 0px'}).observe(menuEl);
  var ro=new IntersectionObserver(function(en){
    en.forEach(function(x){ if(x.isIntersecting) x.target.classList.add('in'); });
  },{threshold:.2});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el){ ro.observe(el); });
}else{ pagebar.classList.add('show'); }

/* ---------------- CTA ---------------- */
function scrollToMenu(){
  var y=menuEl.getBoundingClientRect().top+window.pageYOffset - 4;
  window.scrollTo({top:y,behavior:'smooth'});
}
document.getElementById('goMenu').addEventListener('click',scrollToMenu);

/* ---------------- tilt 3D no logo ---------------- */
var card=document.getElementById('logoCard'), hero=document.getElementById('hero');
function tilt(x,y){
  var r=card.getBoundingClientRect();
  var px=(x-(r.left+r.width/2))/(r.width/2);
  var py=(y-(r.top+r.height/2))/(r.height/2);
  px=Math.max(-1.6,Math.min(1.6,px)); py=Math.max(-1.6,Math.min(1.6,py));
  card.style.transform='rotateY('+(px*11)+'deg) rotateX('+(-py*11)+'deg) translateZ(14px)';
}
hero.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){ tilt(e.clientX,e.clientY); });
hero.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){ if(e.touches[0]) tilt(e.touches[0].clientX,e.touches[0].clientY); },{passive:true});
hero.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(){ card.style.transform=''; });
hero.addEventListener('touchend',function(){ card.style.transform=''; },{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('deviceorientation',function(e){
  if(e.gamma==null||e.beta==null) return;
  var g=Math.max(-24,Math.min(24,e.gamma)), b=Math.max(-24,Math.min(24,e.beta-40));
  card.style.transform='rotateY('+(g*0.42)+'deg) rotateX('+(-b*0.32)+'deg) translateZ(12px)';
});

/* ---------------- partículas + rastro ---------------- */
var cv=document.getElementById('fx'), cx=cv.getContext('2d'), P=[], W=0,H=0,DPR=1;
function resizeFx(){
  DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  W=cv.clientWidth; H=cv.clientHeight;
  cv.width=W*DPR; cv.height=H*DPR; cx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
}
function seed(){
  P=[];
  var n=Math.round(Math.min(34,W/13));
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++) P.push({
    x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*H, r:Math.random()*2.1+.7,
    vy:-(Math.random()*.24+.08), vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.16,
    a:Math.random()*.5+.2, life:Infinity, hue:Math.random()<.25?'#ffffff':'#ffd464'
  });
}
function spark(x,y){
  for(var i=0;i<3;i++) P.push({
    x:x+(Math.random()-.5)*10, y:y+(Math.random()-.5)*10, r:Math.random()*2.4+1.1,
    vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.5, vy:-(Math.random()*1.1+.25),
    a:1, life:52, hue:Math.random()<.4?'#ffffff':'#ffc93c'
  });
  if(P.length>260) P.splice(0,P.length-260);
}
window.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){ if(e.touches[0]) spark(e.touches[0].clientX,e.touches[0].clientY); },{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){ if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&Math.random()<.55) spark(e.clientX,e.clientY); });

var reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
function loop(){
  cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  for(var i=P.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var p=P[i];
    p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy;
    if(p.life!==Infinity){ p.life--; p.a=Math.max(0,p.life/52); p.vy+=.012; if(p.life<=0){P.splice(i,1);continue;} }
    else{ if(p.y<-12){ p.y=H+10; p.x=Math.random()*W; } }
    cx.globalAlpha=p.a*.85; cx.fillStyle=p.hue;
    cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.283); cx.fill();
  }
  cx.globalAlpha=1;
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

/* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
function boot(){
  resizeFx(); seed(); if(!reduce) loop();
  go(0,false); syncHeight();
}
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){
  resizeFx(); seed(); syncHeight(); setX(baseX(),false);
});
window.addEventListener('orientationchange',function(){ setTimeout(function(){ syncHeight(); setX(baseX(),false); },250); });
Array.prototype.forEach.call(track.querySelectorAll('img'),function(im){
  im.addEventListener('load',function(){ syncHeight(); });
});
if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot); else boot();
window.addEventListener('load',function(){ syncHeight(); setX(baseX(),false); });

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
